description: Read-only viewer for a signing audit trail. Renders the trail's events along with a downloadable audit PDF link and a localization snapshot (signing culture, fallback culture, and translated field details) when present.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS classes for the root element.

parameters.name: LocalizationSnapshot
parameters.description: Optional resolved signing localization snapshot captured during the ceremony.

parameters.name: HeaderContent
parameters.description: Host-rendered document summary replacing the default title (the document name, its status badge and timestamp — the desktop reference's header card). The panel renders it verbatim; the audit model carries no document title, so without the slot the localized default title stays (Q-S10).
